messages.content: I've been waiting 2 weeks for a response to my support ticket #TK-4401. This is unacceptable.
I apologize for the delay. We had a backlog. Let me look into your ticket now.
Two weeks is not a 'backlog', it's negligence. I expected better.
You're right, and I'm sorry. The issue in your ticket has been resolved. I've also flagged your account for priority support going forward.
